name: crowded-bus
description: 好挤的大巴 — 网页横屏派对游戏（方块占位版）

scripts.model:build: esbuild scripts/export-layout.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=/tmp/crowdedbus-export-layout.mjs --log-level=warning && node /tmp/crowdedbus-export-layout.mjs > assets-src/layout.json && "${BLENDER:-/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender}" -b --factory-startup -P scripts/blender/build_models.py -- assets-src/layout.json public/models assets-src/crowded_bus.blend
